description: Price of a specific order: plan in a city (and optionally cloud, OS, count, hours). Returns the hourly price per server and in total, the cost for the given hours, the monthly price, and whether the current balance covers the first hour. Without a cloud it picks the cheapest one that deploys there. Does not create anything.

hours.description: How long they run, default 1 hour.

os.description: OS id or name, default "ubuntu-24.04". Windows changes the price.

plan.description: Plan id, e.g. "vc2-1c-1gb", or a plan name like "Micro".

region.description: City id or name, e.g. "fra" or "Frankfurt".

name: quote
title: Price quote
